name: Mask Trim Edges Before Wall Finish
intent: Apply tape and paper to baseboard tops, door casing edges, and window casing edges before wall finish coats. The wall painter cuts to this tape line with a brush. Trim package must be installed and finished prior to this module.
doctrine: All three masking tasks share the PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_EDGES quantity by design. The current source spec treats trim edge LF as a workload aggregate — every LF of trim edge accumulates baseboard, door casing, and window casing masking time. This is an approximation that averages across rooms with different trim mixes; we replicate it faithfully in Phase 0 for engine output parity. A per-trim-type quantity split is a Phase 1+ accuracy improvement.
